mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) in 60%+ of FEDFUNDS decreasing periods over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% pp triggers a shift in investor sentiment toward risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 3.5pp threshold in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in demand (GDPC1) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) create a favorable macroeconomic environment, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.05 over any 2-year window when both proxies are in expected directions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate during a labor market recovery phase signals improved labor conditions, fostering investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive in >70% of labor recovery periods (UNRATE decreasing).

mechanism_narrative: An inflation spike above 2.0% triggers central bank policy tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0% in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in supply growth (INDPRO) combined with a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a dual catalyst for equity appreciation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Combined effect of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS not statistically significant (p>0.05) in 50%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in demand (GDPC1) reflects robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not positive in >80% of GDPC1 increasing periods over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate during a monetary tightening cycle elevates borrowing costs, reducing corporate profit margins and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative in >70% of FEDFUNDS rising periods during tightening cycles.
